You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  all_star: columns=[player_id, year, game_num, game_id, team_id, league_id, gp, starting_pos], fks=[player_id→player]
  appearances: columns=[year, team_id, league_id, player_id, g_all, gs, g_batting, g_defense, g_p, g_c, g_1b, g_2b, g_3b, g_ss, g_lf], fks=[team_id→team, player_id→player]
  manager_award: columns=[player_id, award_id, year, league_id, tie, notes], fks=[player_id→player]
  player_award: columns=[player_id, award_id, year, league_id, tie, notes], fks=[player_id→player]
  manager_award_vote: columns=[award_id, year, league_id, player_id, points_won, points_max, votes_first]
  player_award_vote: columns=[award_id, year, league_id, player_id, points_won, points_max, votes_first], fks=[player_id→player]
  batting: columns=[player_id, year, stint, team_id, league_id, g, ab, r, h, double, triple, hr, rbi, sb, cs], fks=[player_id→player]
  batting_postseason: columns=[year, round, player_id, team_id, league_id, g, ab, r, h, double, triple, hr, rbi, sb, cs], fks=[player_id→player, team_id→team]
  player_college: columns=[player_id, college_id, year], fks=[player_id→player, college_id→college]
  fielding: columns=[player_id, year, stint, team_id, league_id, pos, g, gs, inn_outs, po, a, e, dp, pb, wp], fks=[player_id→player]
  fielding_outfield: columns=[player_id, year, stint, glf, gcf, grf], fks=[player_id→player]
  fielding_postseason: columns=[player_id, year, team_id, league_id, round, pos, g, gs, inn_outs, po, a, e, dp, tp, pb], fks=[player_id→player, team_id→player]
  hall_of_fame: columns=[player_id, yearid, votedby, ballots, needed, votes, inducted, category, needed_note], fks=[player_id→player]
  home_game: columns=[year, league_id, team_id, park_id, span_first, span_last, games, openings, attendance], fks=[team_id→team, park_id→park]
  manager: columns=[player_id, year, team_id, league_id, inseason, g, w, l, rank, plyr_mgr], fks=[team_id→team]
  manager_half: columns=[player_id, year, team_id, league_id, inseason, half, g, w, l, rank], fks=[team_id→team]
  player: columns=[player_id, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day, birth_country, birth_state, birth_city, death_year, death_month, death_day, death_country, death_state, death_city, name_first, name_last]
  park: columns=[park_id, park_name, park_alias, city, state, country]
  pitching: columns=[player_id, year, stint, team_id, league_id, w, l, g, gs, cg, sho, sv, ipouts, h, er]
  pitching_postseason: columns=[player_id, year, round, team_id, league_id, w, l, g, gs, cg, sho, sv, ipouts, h, er]
  salary: columns=[year, team_id, league_id, player_id, salary]
  college: columns=[college_id, name_full, city, state, country]
  postseason: columns=[year, round, team_id_winner, league_id_winner, team_id_loser, league_id_loser, wins, losses, ties]
  team: columns=[year, league_id, team_id, franchise_id, div_id, rank, g, ghome, w, l, div_win, wc_win, lg_win, ws_win, r]
  team_franchise: columns=[franchise_id, franchise_name, active, na_assoc]
  team_half: columns=[year, league_id, team_id, half, div_id, div_win, rank, g, w, l]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['all_star', 'appearances', 'manager_award', 'player_award', 'manager_award_vote', 'player_award_vote', 'batting', 'batting_postseason', 'player_college', 'fielding', 'fielding_outfield', 'fielding_postseason', 'hall_of_fame', 'home_game', 'manager', 'manager_half', 'player', 'park', 'pitching', 'pitching_postseason', 'salary', 'college', 'postseason', 'team', 'team_franchise', 'team_half']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: sports / analytics
  Metrics:  player_batting_average, team_wins, player_salary, era, hall_of_fame_inductions, postseason_appearances
  Goals:    player_performance_analysis, team_season_analysis, award_and_recognition_tracking, salary_and_career_analysis
  Grain:    player_season

Table roles (from Agent 3):

  fielding: fact

  pitching: fact

  salary: fact
  college: dimension
  postseason: fact
  team: dimension
  team_franchise: dimension
  team_half: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  all_star: gp, starting_pos
  appearances: g_all, gs, g_defense, g_dh, g_ph, g_pr
  manager_award: notes
  player_award_vote: points_won, votes_first
  batting: ab, r, h, double, triple, hr, rbi, sb, cs, bb, so, ibb, hbp, sh, sf, g_idp
  batting_postseason: cs, ibb, hbp, sh, sf, g_idp
  fielding: gs, inn_outs, po, a, e, dp, pb, wp, sb, cs, zr
  fielding_outfield: glf, gcf, grf
  fielding_postseason: gs, inn_outs, pb, sb, cs
  hall_of_fame: ballots, needed, votes
  manager: rank
  pitching: ipouts, baopp, era, ibb, wp, hbp, bfp, gf, sh, sf, g_idp
  pitching_postseason: era, ibb, wp, hbp, bk, bfp, sh, sf, g_idp
